description: SDEM's own standard for a complete design: what every design connects, whatever its domain. Shipped with SDEM; a profile includes it as "sdem:sdem-completeness.json". Every rule is a warning — a gap is something still to decide, never a wrong design. A planned record that does not meet a rule is 'unresolved'; an active one is 'not met'. A person may grant an exception (sdem exception grant).

standard.title: A complete design: every record connected
standard.source: ArchiMate 3.2 (which element a relationship joins); the audit of the public twin, docs/design/sdem-completeness-design.md

rules.message: a requirement is met by a process, a capability or a service
rules.reasoning: a requirement nothing realises is a requirement the design does not meet

rules.message: a process realises a capability, a value-stream stage, a service or a requirement — or is a step of a process
rules.reasoning: a process that realises nothing has no stated purpose in the design; a step takes its purpose from the process it is part of

rules.message: a business object is used by a process, an event or a service
rules.reasoning: information nothing uses is not part of the design

rules.message: a channel serves an actor or a role
rules.reasoning: a channel nobody uses

rules.message: an interface belongs to the component that offers it
rules.reasoning: ArchiMate: an application interface is part of an application component

rules.message: an application service is realised by a component or a function
rules.reasoning: a service nothing provides

rules.message: an API operation belongs to an interface
rules.reasoning: an operation outside any interface cannot be called

rules.message: a data entity is used by a component, a function or an operation
rules.reasoning: data nothing reads or writes

rules.message: a technology service is provided by a platform
rules.reasoning: a technology service nothing provides cannot be placed or traced

rules.message: a component has a deployment — an approved link
rules.reasoning: software that runs nowhere

rules.message: a data entity is stored somewhere — an approved link
rules.reasoning: data with no store cannot be traced to a platform or a zone

rules.message: an actor does something in the design, or is served by it
rules.reasoning: an actor nothing serves and who does nothing is outside the design

rules.message: an image or package belongs to a deployment or a platform, or is what a component is built as
rules.reasoning: an artifact nothing deploys

rules.message: a function is performed by a component, realises a service, or automates a process
rules.reasoning: behaviour nothing performs

rules.message: a node sits in a network zone
rules.reasoning: where a node sits decides what may reach it; a node in no zone cannot be placed or drawn

rules.message: platform software runs on a node, or sits in a network zone
rules.reasoning: software that runs nowhere

rules.message: a deployment runs on a node or platform, or belongs to an environment
rules.reasoning: a deployment placed nowhere

rules.message: a product includes a service or a business object, or is part of a product
rules.reasoning: a product that offers nothing is a name, not a part of the design

rules.message: an application event is raised by a component or function, or triggers one — or realises a business event
rules.reasoning: an event nothing raises and nothing reacts to does not happen

rules.message: a capability is realised by a process, is part of or has another capability, or is supported by a service domain
rules.reasoning: a capability nothing delivers and nothing belongs to

rules.message: a business event is raised by a process or triggers one
rules.reasoning: an event outside every process

rules.message: a role is assigned to something, or an actor is assigned to it, or it is served
rules.reasoning: a role nobody plays and that does nothing

rules.message: a business service is realised by a process, serves someone, or is part of a product
rules.reasoning: a service nothing provides and nobody uses

rules.message: a value stream has its stages
rules.reasoning: a value stream with no stages says nothing

rules.message: a stage belongs to a value stream
rules.reasoning: a stage of nothing

rules.message: a field belongs to a data entity
rules.reasoning: a column of no table

rules.message: a solution building block is realised by, or made of, something
rules.reasoning: a building block that builds nothing

rules.message: a network connects something, or belongs to a zone
rules.reasoning: a network nothing is on

rules.message: an environment holds deployments or platforms
rules.reasoning: an empty environment

rules.message: a device sits in a network zone, or runs something
rules.reasoning: a device nowhere

rules.message: a location holds something
rules.reasoning: a location with nothing in it

rules.message: a network zone holds something, or is inside a zone
rules.reasoning: an empty zone

rules.message: a path joins the nodes at its ends
rules.reasoning: a path between nothing

rules.message: a technology interface belongs to a node or software, or an application interface is exposed through it
rules.reasoning: an interface of nothing
